name: RowSafe MCP
description: Database protection and management through the Apache-2.0 RowSafe agent, CLI and MCP server; the separate hosted service requires a RowSafe account. Use local stdio with rowsafe mcp after CLI login or API-key configuration, or the remote Streamable HTTP endpoint https://api.rowsafe.sh/mcp with OAuth or an API key. Capabilities depend on credentials, permissions and transport configuration.
